content: RAG grounding: 'deceptive grounding' (arXiv 2607.09349) — a clinical RAG answer can pass hallucination, faithfulness AND citation checks while citing a real document about the WRONG entity (8-87% peak adversarial; 7.8% production). Domain-fine-tuned medical models are worse. Existing RAGAS/FActScore/faithfulness checks pass by design. Mitigation: entity-attribution verification (per-claim check that cited evidence applies to the queried entity), complete entity-specific retrieval, and a citation invariant that binds citation to the exact fired rule.
